text:
Predicates:
PlayFor(x, y) ::: x plays for football club y.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
LoanedOut(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
Nationality(x, y) ::: x is of nationality y.
Club(x, y) ::: x is a football club y.
Premises:
BornIn(ailtonSilva, 1995) ∧ KnownAs(ailtonSilva, ailton) ::: Ailton Silva was born in 1995 and is known as Ailton.
PlayFor(ailton, nautico) ∧ PlayFor(ailton, braga) ::: Ailton plays for Nautico and was loaned out to Braga.
Nationality(ailtonSilva, brazilian) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazilian footballer.
Club(nautico) ∧ Club(braga) ∧ Club(flu) ::: Nautico, Braga, and Fluminense are football clubs.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (PlayFor(ailtonSilva, x)) ::: Ailton Silva does not play for any football club.
